name: Razorpay API
tagline: India-focused payments platform for accepting cards, UPI, wallets, and bank transfers
description: Razorpay provides a REST API for collecting payments, creating orders, managing refunds, settlements, and related payment workflows primarily for Indian businesses. Developers authenticate with Key ID and Key Secret over Basic Auth, create Orders server-side, and complete checkout via Razorpay Checkout or Payment Links.

auth.details: HTTP Basic Auth with Key ID as username and Key Secret as password (Base64). Keys from Dashboard → Account & Settings → API Keys. Live vs test via key prefix (rzp_live_ / rzp_test_).

pricing.free_tier_limits: No per-request API free quota published; test mode free. Live fees are transaction-based (cards/UPI/netbanking etc.), not request-based.
pricing.paid_plans: Transaction fees vary by method; see pricing page. No separate paid API plan tiers commonly published for core REST.

use_cases: create a payment order for checkout
fetch payment status by payment id
issue a full or partial refund
create a payment link for invoice collection
list settlements or capture authorized payments
